parole.significato: to snort; to pant (to breathe loudly)
parole.testo: From dialectal Middle High German snūben, related to Middle Low German snûven, Middle High German snūfen (“to gasp, pant”), which is part of a group of interrelated forms (see below), ultimately from a Germanic base imitative of the sudden drawing of breath. parole.significato: to drum, to beat a drum
parole.testo: From late Middle High German trumelen, from a common Germanic word giving Danish tromme, Swedish trumma, English drum, etc., and ultimately of imitative origin.
